text: 你看见一个末世论者的成员。
source_text: 你看见一个末世论者的成员。

text: 你看见末世论者的兄弟艾伦。
source_text: 你看见末世论者的兄弟艾伦。

text: 嘿，你好，老兄。有事吗？
source_text: 嘿，你好，老兄。有事吗？

text: 嘿，我能帮你做什么吗？
source_text: 嘿，我能帮你做什么吗？

text: 你好。
source_text: 你好。

text: 嘿，你好，小姐。有事吗？
source_text: 嘿，你好，小姐。有事吗？

text: 哦哇！
source_text: 哦哇！

text: 你好。
source_text: 你好。

text: 我遇到过几个末世论者。你们具体是干什么的？
source_text: 我遇到过几个末世论者。你们具体是干什么的？

text: 我正努力找出一个藏在你们中间的间谍，不过现在还没找到。我能问你们些问题吗？
source_text: 我正努力找出一个藏在你们中间的间谍，不过现在还没找到。我能问你们些问题吗？

text: 哦，嗯, 我主要研究的是哲学和一些其它东西。我的意思是，如果我们要带来和平，那么我们就需要一个好的基础，对吗？
source_text: 哦，嗯, 我主要研究的是哲学和一些其它东西。我的意思是，如果我们要带来和平，那么我们就需要一个好的基础，对吗？

text: 一个值得的目标。
source_text: 一个值得的目标。

text: 你需要的唯一哲学就是一杆枪！
source_text: 你需要的唯一哲学就是一杆枪！

text: 嗯。好吧。那么，我想我会过会儿再和你谈。
source_text: 嗯。好吧。那么，我想我会过会儿再和你谈。

text: 哇！嘿，我想我帮不了你。
source_text: 哇！嘿，我想我帮不了你。

text: 嘿，就是这种态度才造成所有的这些麻烦和问题。冷静点，好吗？
source_text: 嘿，就是这种态度才造成所有的这些麻烦和问题。冷静点，好吗？

text: 嘿，我只是开玩笑而已。
source_text: 嘿，我只是开玩笑而已。

text: 让我给你一点和平……永恒的安宁。
source_text: 让我给你一点和平……永恒的安宁。

text: 嗯，好吧，就这么来吧。
source_text: 嗯，好吧，就这么来吧。

text: 你还想知道什么？
source_text: 你还想知道什么？

text: 你过去有过任何与大教堂教徒的接触吗？
source_text: 你过去有过任何与大教堂教徒的接触吗？

text: 你曾经离开过图书馆吗？
source_text: 你曾经离开过图书馆吗？

text: 你知道有谁经常外出吗？
source_text: 你知道有谁经常外出吗？

text: 不行。我听说他们都是不正常的家伙。我会不想和他们说话。
source_text: 不行。我听说他们都是不正常的家伙。我会不想和他们说话。

text: 不，为什么我要？我喜欢读书。而且无论如何，只有侦察员才到处跑。
source_text: 不，为什么我要？我喜欢读书。而且无论如何，只有侦察员才到处跑。

text: 嗯，只有侦察员和守卫。守卫会偶尔去巡逻一下。我想过做一个守卫，但是……呃，我在一场徒手格斗中给狠揍了一顿，所以我没能做成。嗯，侦察兵，他们会走更远，我想有些时候会直接去到大教堂。
source_text: 嗯，只有侦察员和守卫。守卫会偶尔去巡逻一下。我想过做一个守卫，但是……呃，我在一场徒手格斗中给狠揍了一顿，所以我没能做成。嗯，侦察兵，他们会走更远，我想有些时候会直接去到大教堂。

text: 我没有更多问题了，谢谢。
source_text: 我没有更多问题了，谢谢。

text: 【更多】
source_text: 【更多】

text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

text: You see a member of the 末世论者.
source_text: You see a member of the 末世论者.

text: You see Brother Alan of the 末世论者.
source_text: You see Brother Alan of the 末世论者.

text: Hey, greetings and good day to you, man. What's up?
source_text: Hey, greetings and good day to you, man. What's up?

text: Hiya. What can I do for you?
source_text: Hiya. What can I do for you?

text: Hello.
source_text: Hello.

text: Hey, greetings and good day to you, miss. What's up?
source_text: Hey, greetings and good day to you, miss. What's up?

text: Owoowngh!
source_text: Owoowngh!

text: Hi.
source_text: Hi.

text: I've met a few of the 末世论者. What exactly do you do?
source_text: I've met a few of the 末世论者. What exactly do you do?

text: I'm trying to find a spy within your ranks, but I'm not having much luck. Can I ask you some questions?
source_text: I'm trying to find a spy within your ranks, but I'm not having much luck. Can I ask you some questions?

text: Oh, well, I mostly study philosophy and stuff. I mean, if we're going to bring about peace, then we need a good grounding for it, right?
source_text: Oh, well, I mostly study philosophy and stuff. I mean, if we're going to bring about peace, then we need a good grounding for it, right?

text: A worthwhile cause.
source_text: A worthwhile cause.

text: The only philosophy you need is a big gun!
source_text: The only philosophy you need is a big gun!

text: Hmm. Okay. Well, I guess I'll talk to you later.
source_text: Hmm. Okay. Well, I guess I'll talk to you later.

text: Whoa! Hey, I don't think I can help you.
source_text: Whoa! Hey, I don't think I can help you.

text: Hey, it's exactly that kind of attitude that's causing all this trouble. Just chill out, okay?
source_text: Hey, it's exactly that kind of attitude that's causing all this trouble. Just chill out, okay?

text: Heh. I was just kidding.
source_text: Heh. I was just kidding.

text: Lemme give you a little peace . . . eternal peace.
source_text: Lemme give you a little peace . . . eternal peace.

text: Uh, sure, go ahead.
source_text: Uh, sure, go ahead.

text: What else do you want to know?
source_text: What else do you want to know?

text: Have you had any contact with the Children of the 大教堂?
source_text: Have you had any contact with the Children of the 大教堂?

text: Do you ever leave the library?
source_text: Do you ever leave the library?

text: Do you know of anyone who regularly goes outside?
source_text: Do you know of anyone who regularly goes outside?

text: No way. I hear that they're all freaks. I wouldn't want to talk to them.
source_text: No way. I hear that they're all freaks. I wouldn't want to talk to them.

text: No, why would I? I just like to read. And anyhow, only scouts really get to go anywhere.
source_text: No, why would I? I just like to read. And anyhow, only scouts really get to go anywhere.

text: Well, just the scouts and the guards. The guards go and patrol a little bit once in a while. I wanted to be a guard but . . . well, I got my ass kicked in # hand-to-hand combat, so I couldn't go. Um, the scouts, they go a lot farther, # sometimes all the way to the 大教堂, I think.
source_text:

text: No more questions, thanks.
